auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a sign-in link and a 6-digit code.
auth.checkEmailBody: Tap the link in the email, or type the 6-digit code here.
auth.invalidCode: That code did not work. Check it and try again.
auth.callbackFailed: That sign-in link did not work. Please try again from the sign-in page.
auth.needOnline: You need an internet connection to sign in.

onboarding.title: What should we call you?
onboarding.name: Your name
onboarding.age: I am 18 or older, and I will use this to keep score with people I know.

cards.c1b: Top-ups, shorts and repays in two or three taps. No more "I paid you back at 11".
cards.c2b: Share the live link. Every entry shows who recorded it and when.
cards.c3b: Count chips, see if it matches, and get who-pays-whom in one screen.

home.quickStartHint: Start now with a new group named after today
home.noNights: No nights yet. Your first one will show up here.
home.emptyTitle: The table is empty. Bring in your crew.
home.emptyBody: Start a night and add everyone who is playing. We will remember the group for next time.

wizard.title: New night
wizard.addPersonPlaceholder: Type a name and press Enter
wizard.kittyHint: A fixed amount for food or the host. It stays out of the chip math.
wizard.chipCounterHint: Count chips by color at the end

live.endGameBody: Top-ups and shorts are locked while you count chips. You can always go back to the game.
live.topUpBody: {name} gives the bank {amount} cash and gets {amount} in chips.
live.typoBody: That is {n} buy-ins. Are you sure?
live.readOnly: You are watching this night. Only the host can record.
live.notHost: You are not the host anymore
live.rejectedTitle: You are not the host anymore, so {count, plural, one {this entry was not} other {these # entries were not}} saved:
live.rejectedHint: Ask the new host to re-enter them.
live.nobodyToAdd: Everyone in the group is at the table. Add someone new.
live.lastPlayer: Only one player would be left. End the game instead?

leave.title: {name} leaves
leave.deferred: {amount} will be settled at the end of the night.
leave.bankShort: Bank only has {bank}. Pay {bank} now and {rest} at the end?
leave.bankHolderBlocked: {name} holds the bank. Hand over the bank first.
leave.hostBlocked: You are the host. Hand over hosting first, or end the night.

bank.shouldHold: The bank should have {amount}. Want to count it?
bank.handoverExpected: The bank should have {amount}. Count the cash and enter what is actually there.

host.pickMember: Pick a player who is signed in
host.scanHint: They open this link while signed in, and they become the host.
host.noLoggedIn: Nobody else here has an account yet. Use the QR code instead.
host.needSync: Syncing {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}…
host.needOnline: Handing over needs an internet connection. Connect and try again.
host.takeOverBody: We have not heard from the host in {minutes} min. As a group admin, you can take over.
host.takeOverWait: The host was last active {minutes} min ago. You can take over once they have been quiet for 10 minutes.
host.acceptBody: You will record everything from now on. The old phone can only watch.
host.offline: The host is offline. Last update {minutes} min ago.

combined.title: Leaving as host and bank holder

count.title: Final count
count.left: {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} left to count
count.missingCauses: Usually this means a chip repay or an early leave was not recorded, some chips were put away, or someone miscounted.
count.extraCauses: Usually this means a short or top-up was not recorded, someone's own chips got mixed in, or someone miscounted.

settle.title: Results
settle.closeOutbox: Waiting for {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} to sync before closing…

share.title: Share live link
share.body: Anyone with this link can watch the table and the full log. They do not need to sign in.
share.needSync: The link works once this night syncs.

group.inviteBody: Anyone with this link can join the group or claim their name. Expires in 7 days.
group.name: Group name
group.chipSetHint: Chip colors and values for the chip counter
group.noStats: Close a night to see the leaderboard.
group.noGroups: No groups yet. Start a night to make one.

history.title: History
history.claimHint: Claim your name in a group to see your stats.
history.chartLabel: Running net {net} over {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}}

me.title: Me
me.deleteBody: This removes your profile and unlinks your name in every group. Group history keeps the nickname. This cannot be undone.
me.signOutUnsynced: {count, plural, one {# entry has} other {# entries have}} not synced yet. Signing out deletes {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} from this phone.
me.iosInstallBody: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

viewer.notSynced: This night has not synced yet. It will show up once the host is back online.
viewer.expired: This link has expired or was turned off.
viewer.thisIsMeBody: Sign in to add this night to your history.

join.title: Join {group}
join.body: Are you already on the list? Claim your name to keep your history.

landing.sub: Track buy-ins, top-ups and shorts at teen patti night. See exactly where the count went wrong. Settle up in two minutes.
landing.f1b: Every short and repay is logged the moment it happens, with who recorded it and when.
landing.f2b: Share a live link. Friends watch the table update from their own phones.
landing.f3b: At the end, count the chips. If the table is off, you will see by how much and what probably went wrong.
landing.f4b: Who pays whom, in the fewest transfers. Share it on WhatsApp.
landing.f5b: Play a whole night in airplane mode. Everything syncs when you are back online.
landing.noMoney: Hisaab never moves or holds money. It only keeps score.
landing.adults: For adults (18+) keeping score with people they know.
landing.closer: Bring the chips. We will keep the hisaab.

install.title: Install Hisaab
install.body: Add it to your home screen so it opens instantly, even offline.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Open Hisaab once while online and it works without signal after that.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.not_live: Counting has started. Go back to the game first.
errors.settle_out_of_range: That is more than what is owed
errors.table_full: A table can have at most 12 players
errors.gap_not_zero: The count does not match yet
errors.void_breaks_log: A later entry depends on this one. Void that first.
errors.bank_holder_must_handover: Hand over the bank before leaving
